consistency_checks.result: The Internet Archive raw copy of 13 July 2026 carries the same field_latitude/field_longitude and the same address, so the coordinates predate the 20 August 2026 page version and were not changed by it.

consistency_checks.result: In Esri World Imagery z18 tiles the point lies on the north side of a street at the south-east gate of a walled compound that holds one large flat-roofed building (very roughly 55 m by 60 m) with rows of rooftop plant units, consistent with a 2,500 m2 data-centre building. Esri World Street Map z17 labels the street at the point 'Kongoni Rd', about 115 m west-south-west of its junction with 'Beach Rd', matching the operator address 'Kongoni Road, off Beach Rd'. The surrounding blocks are residential and hotel buildings.

The MBA1 page point (-4.00833, 39.60574) is 11.13 km west-north-west, on the Mombasa Road (A109) carriageway at Miritini; MBA1 is a separate facility and is held in this fragment (point on the road, building not identified).

not_used: No Google, Apple, Bing, HERE, Waze, Yandex or other commercial map coordinates, no PeeringDB record and no OpenStreetMap API, Overpass or extract were used for this locator.
